claim_en: THE SPIES SENT: WE JOURNEYED FROM HOREB THROUGH THE GREAT AND TERRIBLE WILDERNESS TO KADESH-BARNEA; YOU HAVE COME TO THE HILL COUNTRY OF THE AMORITES — GO UP, POSSESS, FEAR NOT, NEITHER BE DISMAYED; YOU ALL CAME NEAR: LET US SEND MEN TO SEARCH OUT THE LAND; I TOOK TWELVE, ONE PER TRIBE; THEY WENT UP TO THE VALLEY OF ESHCOL, SPIED IT OUT, BROUGHT DOWN ITS FRUIT AND SAID: GOOD IS THE LAND. 'The great and terrible wilderness' plene one seat; 'FEAR NOT, NEITHER BE DISMAYED' the pair's only Torah seat; 'AND THEY SHALL SEARCH OUT' the dig-root's spy sense here and Joshua 2:2-3 alone; 'twelve men' and 'one man per tribe' with Joshua 4:2 and 3:12, the parser [12, 1]; 'the valley of Eshcol' Numbers 13:23 and this; 'AND THEY SPIED IT OUT' the spy-verb's piel where Numbers 13-14 say 'tour' twelve tokens; 'SOME OF THE FRUIT OF THE LAND' Moses' charge (Numbers 13:20) and this; 'GOOD IS THE LAND' JOSHUA AND CALEB'S WORDS (Numbers 14:7) and this. The Sifrei 18:2: serpents like beams and scorpions like bows — a fortiori; 19: the tutor and the prince's vines; not by hearsay; 'go up, possess' at once; 20: 'all of you' a mob against 5:20's order; R. Shimon's scorn — spies now, not in the desert; the word as the language; the road's ambushes; 21: good in Moses' eyes, not the Omnipresent's (the donkey sold too eagerly); the choicest; Levi not among them; 22: the spies' way the hills (Rahab); Eshcol named for its end (Horeb likewise); walked warp and woof; 23: grabbed like figs for a coin; the land higher than all; only Joshua and Caleb spoke its good — yet 'you would not go up'.
middah: ink (the pair's, the verbs' and the phrases' seats; the two spy-verbs measured against Numbers 13-14); I1 (18:2); E7 (20:1 — 'all of you' against 5:20); I5 (21:3 — 'one per tribe' after 'twelve'); the naming rule (22:2 — named for its end); the attribution from the seats (23:3 — Joshua and Caleb's words)

check.note: 'Eshcol' — the valley of the cluster, Numbers 13:23 and this; the Sifrei 22:2: named for its end

claim_en: THE REFUSAL: YOU WOULD NOT GO UP AND REBELLED AGAINST THE MOUTH OF THE LORD, MURMURED IN YOUR TENTS — IN HIS HATRED HE BROUGHT US OUT TO GIVE US TO THE AMORITE; OUR BROTHERS HAVE MELTED OUR HEART: A PEOPLE GREATER AND TALLER, CITIES FORTIFIED TO HEAVEN, SONS OF ANAKIM; AND I SAID: DREAD NOT — THE LORD WHO GOES BEFORE YOU WILL FIGHT FOR YOU AS IN EGYPT, WHO CARRIED YOU AS A MAN CARRIES HIS SON, YET YOU DO NOT BELIEVE HIM WHO SOUGHT YOUR CAMP IN FIRE BY NIGHT AND CLOUD BY DAY. 'You rebelled against the mouth of the LORD' three seats, all this book's (Onkelos: 'against the Memra'); 'AND YOU MURMURED IN YOUR TENTS' three Bible seats, Psalm 106:25's retelling among them; 'in the LORD's hatred' one seat; 'into the hand of the Amorite' this and Joshua 7:7; 'melted our heart' one seat, Caleb's kin (Joshua 14:8); 'fortified to heaven' plene 1:28, 9:1 defective; 'sons of Anakim' 1:28 and 9:2 (Onkelos 'giants' for Anakim and Rephaim alike); 'HE WILL FIGHT FOR YOU' Exodus 14:14's at its second seat; 'as a man carries his son' one seat (the outside row 314:2's eagle); 'you do not believe' one seat (Onkelos 'in the Memra'); 'in fire by night and in cloud by day' reversing Exodus 13:21's order. The Sifrei 24: the murmurer's words split by a knife from heaven; the weeping over sons and daughters; it is they who hate; Joshua 7:9 at 1:27; 25: from our own kin; tall; many; HYPERBOLE — Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel (9:1's 'today') against the promise to Abraham; giants on giants; not from myself; the God of Egypt's wonders; believe the past.
middah: ink (the seats of the rebellion, the murmuring, the hatred and the fight-clause censused; the order of fire and cloud measured against Exodus 13:21); E7 (24:1 — the murmurer from Proverbs 26:22); the hyperbole rule (25:4 — the text may exaggerate, the promise may not); LR1 (24:4 — Joshua 7:9 taught at 1:27)

check.note: 'and you murmured' — the murmur-verb's three Bible seats, Psalm 106:25 retelling this one

claim_en: THE OATH: THE LORD HEARD THE VOICE OF YOUR WORDS, WAS ANGRY AND SWORE — NOT ONE OF THIS EVIL GENERATION SHALL SEE THE GOOD LAND, EXCEPT CALEB WHO FOLLOWED THE LORD FULLY; WITH ME TOO HE WAS ANGRY FOR YOUR SAKES — YOU SHALL NOT GO IN; JOSHUA WHO STANDS BEFORE YOU SHALL, ENCOURAGE HIM; YOUR LITTLE ONES WHO YOU SAID WOULD BE A PREY, WHO KNOW NOT GOOD AND EVIL, SHALL GO IN; BUT YOU, TURN TO THE WILDERNESS BY THE SEA OF REEDS. 'The LORD heard the voice of your words' 1:34 and 5:28 (Onkelos 'it was heard before the LORD'); 'this evil generation' one seat; 'the good land' five Torah seats; 'BECAUSE HE FOLLOWED THE LORD FULLY' 1:36 and Joshua 14:14 — Caleb's Hebron; the fill-after phrase eight seats (Onkelos supplies 'the fear of the LORD'); 'THE LORD WAS ANGRY WITH ME FOR YOUR SAKES' the hitpael's six seats, 'for your sakes' 1:37 and Micah 3:12 (Onkelos 'there was anger from before the LORD' — fourteen seats of the phrase); 'who stands before you' one seat; 'he shall cause Israel to inherit it' one seat; 'YOUR LITTLE ONES WHO YOU SAID WOULD BE A PREY' NUMBERS 14:31 VERBATIM; 'GOOD AND EVIL' the tree's four seats (Genesis 2:9, 2:17, 3:5, 3:22) and this; 1:40 against Numbers 14:25 — the pronoun moved, the directional ending added. No piska on these verses: the shelf's silence begins at 1:31.
middah: ink (the oath's, the clause's and Eden's phrase's seats censused; 1:39 matched verbatim to Numbers 14:31; 1:40 diffed against 14:25); the translation's supplements measured (the fear, the anger from before)

check.note: 'was angry' — the hitpael's six seats; with me also the LORD was angry for your sakes

claim_en: THE PRESUMPTUOUS ASCENT: YOU ANSWERED — WE HAVE SINNED AGAINST THE LORD, WE WILL GO UP AND FIGHT — GIRDED YOUR WEAPONS AND DEEMED IT EASY TO GO UP; THE LORD SAID: GO NOT UP, FOR I AM NOT AMONG YOU; YOU DID NOT HEAR, REBELLED, ACTED PRESUMPTUOUSLY AND WENT UP; THE AMORITE CHASED YOU AS BEES DO AND BEAT YOU DOWN IN SEIR TO HORMAH; YOU WEPT AND THE LORD DID NOT LISTEN; YOU DWELT IN KADESH MANY DAYS. 'We have sinned against the LORD' where Numbers 14:40 said 'we have sinned'; 'AND YOU DEEMED IT EASY' a hapax (Onkelos 'you began'); 1:42 against Numbers 14:42 — 'I am not among you' for 'the LORD is not' (Onkelos 'MY SHEKHINAH DOES NOT DWELL AMONG YOU'); 'you rebelled against the mouth' the second of three; 'acted presumptuously' the seethe-root (Jacob's pottage, the presumptuous prophet); 'AS THE BEES DO' the bee-word four seats, the consonants 'the words' (Onkelos 'as the bees scatter'); Numbers 14:45's 'beat them down to Hormah' become 'beat you down in Seir to Hormah'; 'AND THE LORD DID NOT LISTEN TO YOUR VOICE' one seat — Onkelos 'DID NOT ACCEPT YOUR PRAYER', the very words it gives 3:26's 'would not hear me'; 'many days' 1:46, 2:1, 20:19. No piska on these verses.
middah: ink (the hapax, the bee-word, the Hormah clause and the listening clause censused; 1:42 diffed against Numbers 14:42); the translation's one phrase at two seats measured (1:45 and 3:26 — the people's weeping and Moses' plea)

check.note: 'the bees' — the consonants of 'the words', the morphology deciding; the bee-word's four seats
